content:
iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Ultra will be released next month, equipped with a brand-new A20 Pro chip; this weekend, a reputable leaker shared the expected performance improvements based on supply chain information.

The A20 Pro chip is expected to be 18% faster and deliver 30% better power efficiency.

Apple's major September event will unveil their latest achievement in silicon technology: the A20 Pro chip.

The A20 Pro will be Apple's first chip manufactured using TSMC's 2nm process. Reports also indicate the new chip will adopt a brand-new Wafer-Level Multi-Chip Module (WMCM) packaging technology.

Based on these innovations, we have been expecting this year's chip to deliver larger improvements than ever before.

Weibo leaker "Fixed Focus Digital" posted over the weekend, citing supply chain sources to outline the following upgrades of the A20 Pro over the A19 Pro:

  • 18% faster performance
  • 30% better power efficiency

More specific figures will of course have to wait for Apple's full announcement next month. Apple has historically listed separate improvements for the CPU, GPU, and Neural Engine.

However, if these numbers are accurate, the gains are quite impressive. The efficiency improvements should translate into longer battery life while still delivering the best performance ever.

Combined with the speed boosts in iOS 27 itself, the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Ultra are shaping up to be highly anticipated performance upgrades.

What do you think about the rumored improvements for the A20 Pro? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
